Allah swears by the angels who take out the souls of some people with force.
And by the angels who take out the souls of others gently.
And by the angels who glide quickly, as if they were swimming through the air.
And by the angels who race ahead to do His orders.
And by the angels who take care of the matters Allah commands.
On the Day when the first blast of the Trumpet shakes everything.
And the second blast follows it.
On that Day hearts will be shaking with fear.
Their eyes will be looking down in shame.
These people say now: Will we really be brought back to life as we were?
Even after we have become old, rotten bones?
They say: If that is true, it would be a losing return for us! They say this to make fun.
It will only be one great shout.
And suddenly they will all be awake and standing on the earth.
Allah asks the Prophet: Has the story of Musa reached you?
When his Lord called him in the holy valley called Tuwa.
Go to Pharaoh, because he has gone far past all limits.
Ask him: Would you like to become clean and pure?
And would you like me to guide you to your Lord so that you will respect Him?
Musa showed him the biggest sign, the great miracles.
But Pharaoh said it was a lie and disobeyed.
Then he turned away and worked hard against the message.
He gathered his people and called out to them.
And said: I am your highest lord!
So Allah punished him, and made him a lesson for this life and the next.
In this there is a lesson for anyone who has fear of Allah.
Allah asks: Are you harder to create, or the sky that He built?
He raised it high and made it perfect.
He made its night dark and brought out its daylight.
After that He spread out the earth.
He brought out its water and its green plants.
And He set the mountains firmly in place.
All of this is for you and your animals to enjoy.
But when the greatest Overwhelming event comes.
On that Day a person will remember everything he worked for.
And Hell will be shown clearly to everyone who sees.
As for the person who went past the limits.
And chose the life of this world over the next life.
Hell will be his home.
But as for the person who feared standing before his Lord and stopped himself from following bad desires.
Paradise will be his home.
They ask you about the Hour: When will it come?
It is not for you to say when it will come.
Only your Lord knows when it will happen.
You are only a warner for those who fear it.
On the day they see it, it will feel to them as if they only stayed in this world for one evening or one morning. It will seem so short.
